signal: IFS completed its acquisition of Softeon, launching IFS Softeon for end-to-end supply chain intelligence

email.body1:
Zachary, saw IFS completed the Softeon acquisition, launching IFS Softeon for end-to-end supply chain intelligence.

A merger like that floods the funnel with new accounts, and buying signals pile up faster than the team can route and act on them. Our AI SDR turns a signal into a researched, written, followed-up touch with zero human time per prospect: 3-5x more meetings per rep, every email auto-logged to your CRM.

I built a personalized signal play for Softeon off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Zachary, quick follow-up for Softeon.

From a sales ops seat, the cost of a merger is signal-to-action latency: combined account data arrives, but the motion to work it stays manual, slow, and hard to measure. Cleaning that up is usually the fastest measurable lift before adding headcount.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50-70%, and I'll show where Softeon's flow is leaking replies.
email.body3:
Zachary, last bit of proof for Softeon.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Softeon's reply rate likely compares to other supply chain software companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Zachary, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Post-merger integration is its own kind of busy, and timing is everything.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales ops motion? I'll tailor it to Softeon either way.
